reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20/agent-P override of prior batch-074 source-scope retrenchment. Original marked-correct option B ('15-20% of PROJECT COST to socialized housing') is factually wrong. RA 10884 sets 15% (subdivision) or 5% (condominium) of total area OR project cost. The '15-20%' range does not exist in the statute.

source_audit_support.source_locator: RA 10884 Section 2(b) amending RA 7279 Section 18. External verification via Lawphil and Supreme Court E-Library.
source_audit_support.local_source_safe_action: Agent-P council pass: externally verified RA 10884 figure (15% subdivision).

proposed.text: A developer constructs a 500-hectare residential subdivision for sale to middle-income buyers under PD 957. To comply with RA 10884 (Balanced Housing Development), the developer must allocate:

options.text: At least 30% of the total area as non-buildable open space (parks, roads, facilities) under PD 1216
At least 15% of the total subdivision area or project cost, at the developer's option, devoted to socialized housing or an equivalent compliance mode
A minimum of 100 hectares reserved for low-cost housing units
50% of units sold at below-market rates to low-income families

rationale.a: Wrong. The 30% figure is the PD 1216/PD 957 non-buildable open space requirement for subdivisions of 1 hectare or more, not a balanced-housing allocation.
rationale.b: Correct. RA 10884 (2016), Section 2(b) amending RA 7279 Section 18, requires subdivision developers to develop socialized housing equivalent to at least 15% of total subdivision area or project cost at the developer's option. Compliance modes include on-site units, off-site units, joint venture with NHA, or bond contribution.
rationale.c: Wrong. RA 10884 does not set a fixed hectare reservation; it sets a percentage of area or cost.
rationale.d: Wrong. RA 10884 does not require a 50% below-market-rate quota.
rationale.correct: RA 10884 (2016) sets subdivision balanced housing at 15% of total area or project cost at the developer's option (down from RA 7279's original 20%). For condominiums, the figure is 5%.
rationale.takeaway: RA 10884 reduced RA 7279's 20% subdivision share to a fixed 15% (or 5% for condominiums). The '15-20%' range found in older reviewers is incorrect.

proposed.explanation: RA 10884 Section 2(b) amends RA 7279 Section 18: subdivisions = at least 15% of total area or project cost.
